𝒟𝒾𝒸𝒾𝓃𝑒𝓂𝒶 3/1/2025 6:15 PM
A "little" is a new member of a fraternity who is paired with an older member called a "big". The "big" mentors the "little" and is usually a friend to them.
  • "Little" is short for "little brother" or "little sister"
  • The "big-little" relationship is a mentorship program and tradition in Greek organizations
  • The "matching" process pairs new members with initiated members who have similar interests, majors, values, or backgrounds
  • Some chapters have events to help new members meet potential mentors
  • The "family" structure includes a "grandbig" (the big's big) and "great-grandbig"
  • The "family" structure provides mentorship from different class years and connects new members to the larger chapter
